text: Hubby said 'five minutes.' I left yesterday.
Told the group chat 'almost there.' That was Tuesday.
Gas hit $5, so I got a ride that eats lettuce.
'Mom, hurry up!' This IS me hurrying, sweetie.
No EMI, no petrol, no parking. Just vibes.
Me sprinting to the Monday meeting.
Retirement plan: no alarm, no boss, no hurry.
